steps.action: Check what the change means, second paragraph: at an Approval Status with one Pending and one Rejected approval, a confirmed send from the Signatures tab moves the Contract to a Signature Status, does not open Move past approval, and records no override; only the Stage control shows the warning
steps.expected: No Move past approval dialog; an Out for signature row; the Contract is at a Signature Status; approvals stay Pending and Rejected; History has a status change and no override entry.
steps.actual: C-58 stood at "Awaiting approval" (approval) with ["Daniel Okafor:pending","Priya Raman:rejected"]. Signatures > Send for signature: Version "Version 1 — doc032-contracts-2-V-C15-legal_team_member-send.pdf (current)", one Signer, "Yes, all required signatures will be in place", Send envelope closed the dialog; Move past approval did not open within 12 s. The tab showed "pdf Version 1 Out for signature Sep 28 Prepared by Nadia Haddad —". The Contract is now "Out for signature" (signature); approvals still ["Daniel Okafor:pending","Priya Raman:rejected"]. History: "Nadia Haddad changed the status Awaiting approval → Out for signature this minute Nadia H", and no override entry.

steps.action: Electronic signing, third paragraph: a Signed Envelope can show Filing the signed copy… while OpenLaw stores the returned file; wait for Executed copy, then check the Document Version
steps.expected: After the stand-in signs, the row reads Signed and then offers Executed copy; the Documents tab holds the executed Version.
steps.actual: Envelope sent for C-58; the stand-in signed it and its Connect delivery answered 204. The Signatures tab then read "pdf Version 1 Signed Sep 28 Prepared by Nadia Haddad Sep 28 Executed copy" (Filing the signed copy… was not caught between reloads); it offers 1 "Executed copy" link. Documents: 1 executed Version (["doc032-contracts-2-V-C15-legal_team_member-send (executed).pdf"]); Documents tab row "t · theirs Redline · theirs Redline · ours Partially signed Executed Amendment v2 Executed Sep 28 Uploaded by Nadia Haddad NH". The Contract is now "Active" (active).

steps.page: /contracts/:number/signatures Filing the signed copy… then failure
steps.action: Electronic signing, third paragraph: while the returned file is not yet stored the row shows Filing the signed copy…; when filing fails it shows The signed copy could not be filed. Upload it to the record instead.; manual hand-off remains available
steps.expected: Filing the signed copy… under Signed, then the failure text; no Executed copy; the Contract stays in the Signature Stage; the Documents tab still offers manual upload and Mark as executed copy.
steps.actual: C-59: sent (Out for signature), stand-in signed it with its executed download answering 503; delivery 204. The row read "Sep 28 Prepared by Nadia Haddad Sep 28 Filing the signed copy…". After the fetch retries ran out (100 s) it read "Signed Sep 28 Prepared by Nadia Haddad Sep 28 The signed copy could not be filed. Upload it to the record instead."; 0 Executed copy links. The Contract stays "Out for signature" (signature). Manual hand-off: the primary Document's actions offer ["Mark as executed copy","Add version","Edit details","Move to folder","Mark confidential","Archive"].

steps.action: Electronic signing, third paragraph: a round that does not complete the Contract shows Partially signed copy; that file is not marked as executed and the Contract stays in the Signature Stage
steps.expected: Row offers Partially signed copy, not Executed copy; no executed Version; the Contract is at a Signature Status (Partially signed).
steps.actual: C-60: sent with "No, more signatures will still be needed"; the stand-in signed it (delivery 204). The Contract is "Partially signed" (signature).

The Contract has 1 Envelope; the stand-in holds 19 envelopes in total (none created for this round).
